traffic_columns.workload_id: Stable alias mapped to application hashes in workload_manifest.csv
traffic_columns.request_count: Sum of observed HTTP invocation counts; arrival-intensity proxy
traffic_columns.split: train, validation, or test, assigned by the observed minute

source_field_mapping.request_count: sum source minute columns over HTTP functions in each application

missing_counts: Empty CSV fields mean unobserved, not zero; no imputation
duplicate_policy: Exclude an application's day if an HTTP function key repeats
arrival_semantics: Source counts are recorded after execution; exact arrivals are unavailable

forecast_convention_for_later_work.prediction_time: Minute boundary t; latest complete count is y[t-1]
